pages.body:
Why This Book Exists


Have you ever looked at a blueprint? A blueprint is a plan. It is a drawing. It shows you what a building will look like before it is built. It shows you the walls. It shows you the doors. It shows you the windows. It shows you the layout. A blueprint is a promise. It is a promise that something is coming.


The Old Testament is a blueprint. It is a plan. It is a drawing. It shows us what the Messiah would look like before He came. It shows us the details. It shows us the town where He would be born. It shows us the way He would die. It shows us the words people would say. It is a blueprint. It is a promise. It is a plan.


This blueprint was written over 1,000 years before Jesus was born. It was written by different authors. It was written in different countries. It was written in different centuries. But it all fits together. It all points to one person. That person is Jesus.


This book is for the curious. It is for the spiritual seeker who wants to see the plan. It is for the person who wants to understand the blueprint. Over the next 30 days, we are going to look at 30 details of this blueprint. We are going to unlock the prophecies. We are going to see the plan. And we are going to see the one who was planned from the beginning.


The Value You Will Get


By the end of this book, you will not see the Old Testament as a random collection of stories. You will see it as a blueprint. You will see it as a plan. You will see it as a promise. You will understand the messianic prophecies. You will understand why they are so specific. You will understand why they cannot be faked. You will see the hand of God in the details. You will have a new confidence in your faith. You will have a new love for your Bible. And you will have a new...

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint? It is a drawing. It is a plan. It shows you what is coming. The first blueprint in the Bible is a promise. It is a promise about a seed. It is a promise about a hero. It is a promise about a descendant. It is a promise about Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel." - Genesis 3:15 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


This is the first prophecy in the Bible. God is speaking to a snake. But He is not just speaking to a snake. He is speaking to the devil. He is speaking to the enemy. He says a descendant of a woman will come. That descendant will crush the serpent's head. The serpent will strike his heel. It sounds like a riddle. It sounds like a code. It is the first line in the blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"But when the set time had fully come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law..." - Galatians 4:4


Jesus is that descendant. He was born of a woman. He came to crush the serpent's head. He came to defeat the devil. On the cross, it looked like the serpent won. The heel was struck. Jesus died. But three days later, He rose from the dead. The serpent's head was crushed. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is not a coincidence. The first prophecy in the Bible is about a hero. The greatest hero in the Bible is Jesus. The pattern is exact. The blueprint is precise. The plan is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you feel like the snake is winning? Do you feel like the enemy is too strong? Do you feel like you are losing the battle? Remember the first prophecy. The hero is coming. The hero has come. The serpent's head is crushed. You are on the winning side.


The Prayer
God, thank you for the first prophecy. Thank you for the promise of a hero. Thank you for Jesus. Thank you for crushing the serpent's head. Thank you for winning the victory. Help me to live in that victory today. Amen.

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a family? It is a family tree. It shows you the roots. It shows you the branches. It shows you the descendants. The Bible has a family tree. It is a blueprint. It shows us the line of the Messiah. It shows us the family of Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all peoples on earth will be blessed through you." - Genesis 12:3 (Written around 2000 B.C.)


God spoke to Abraham. He told him to leave his home. He told him to go to a new land. He gave him a promise. He said, "I will bless you. I will make your name great. You will be a blessing. All peoples on earth will be blessed through you." This was a huge promise. It meant that one day, someone from Abraham's family would change the world. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"This is the genealogy of Jesus the Messiah the son of David, the son of Abraham..." - Matthew 1:1


The Gospel of Matthew opens with a family tree. It traces the line of Jesus back to Abraham. It shows that Jesus is a descendant of Abraham. He is the one who brings blessing to the whole world. Through Jesus, people from every nation can be forgiven. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
For this prophecy to be fulfilled, the Messiah had to be Jewish. He had to come from a specific family line. The odds of this being a coincidence are tiny. The Bible traces the lineage from Abraham to Jesus with precision. It is another line in the blueprint.


The Resonance
You are not an accident. You are part of a bigger story. God's plan is not just for one person. It is not just for one group. It is for the whole world. And you are included. You are part of the blessing.


The Prayer
God, thank you for keeping your promises. Thank you that your plan has always been bigger than one person or one nation. Thank you that Jesus came to bless the whole world, including me. Help me to see that I am part of your story. Help me to share the blessing with others. Amen.

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a kingdom? It shows you the throne. It shows you the king. It shows you the royal line. The Bible has a blueprint for a kingdom. It is a blueprint for the line of kings. It is a blueprint for the King of Kings.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler's staff from between his feet, until he to whom it belongs shall come and the obedience of the nations shall be his." - Genesis 49:10 (Written around 1800 B.C.)


Jacob was dying. He gathered his twelve sons around his bed. He gave each son a blessing. He gave each son a prophecy. When he got to Judah, he said something strange. He said the scepter would not depart from Judah. A scepter is a stick a king holds. It is a sign of authority. Jacob was saying that the line of kings would come from Judah. He was saying that one day, the ultimate King would come. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"For it is clear that our Lord descended from Judah..." - Hebrews 7:14


Jesus was from the tribe of Judah. The New Testament makes this clear. He is the King of Kings. He is the one who will rule the nations. The dying words of Jacob were not just a family blessing. They were a prophecy about Jesus. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
The Jewish people had twelve tribes. They were all different. They all had different roles. But the Messiah had to come from one specific tribe. The odds of this being random are small. The Bible got it right. It is another line in the blueprint.


The Resonance
History is not random. It is not just a bunch of accidents. There is a pattern hidden in the chaos. God is not just watching. God is directing. The blueprint is real.


The Prayer
God, you are the King of Kings. Thank you for your plan that unfolds across thousands of years. Thank you that you are in control of history. Thank you that you are in control of my history. Help me to trust you with my future. Help me to trust you with my life. Amen.

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint in the sky? Have you ever looked at the stars and seen a message? The Bible has a blueprint in the sky. It is a blueprint of a star. It is a blueprint of a sign. It is a blueprint of a king.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob; a scepter will rise out of Israel." - Numbers 24:17 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Balaam was a pagan prophet. He was hired by a king to curse Israel. But God would not let him. God turned his curses into blessings. God gave him a vision. Balaam saw a star. He saw a scepter. He saw a king. He saw the future. He said a star would come out of Jacob. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews? We saw his star when it rose and have come to worship him." - Matthew 2:2


When Jesus was born, wise men came from the east. They were star gazers. They saw a star in the sky. They knew the ancient prophecy. They knew a star would signal the birth of a king. They traveled hundreds of miles to find Him. The star led them to Jesus. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a strange prophecy. It was spoken by a nonbeliever. It was spoken 1,400 years before Jesus was born. It connects a star to a king. And the story of the wise men lines up perfectly. It is another line in the blueprint.


The Resonance
The stars themselves were pointing to a king. The universe is not silent. It speaks. It points. If the stars can point to a king, maybe there is a God who wants to be found. Maybe there is a God who is calling you.


The Prayer
God, the heavens declare your glory. Thank you for putting signs in the sky that point to Jesus. Thank you for the wise men who followed the star. Help me to follow the clues that lead to you. Help me to seek you with all my heart. Amen.
pages.title: Day 4: The Blueprint of the Star

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a prophet? It shows you the voice. It shows you the message. It shows you the messenger. The Bible has a blueprint for a prophet. It is a blueprint for the one who would speak God's words. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their fellow Israelites, and I will put my words in his mouth. He will tell them everything I command him." - Deuteronomy 18:18 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Moses was talking to the people. He said, "God will raise up a prophet like me." This was a massive claim. Moses was the greatest prophet in Jewish history. But he said someone else was coming. This new prophet would speak God's words. The people were supposed to listen to Him. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"For Moses said, 'The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your own people; you must listen to everything he tells you.'" - Acts 3:22


Peter quotes this prophecy in the book of Acts. He applies it to Jesus. Jesus is the new Moses. Moses led people out of physical slavery in Egypt. Jesus leads people out of spiritual slavery to sin. Moses gave the law. Jesus gives grace. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
The Jews were waiting for this prophet. They asked John the Baptist, "Are you the prophet?" They knew the prophecy. They were looking for someone like Moses. Jesus fulfilled that expectation. He was the greater Moses. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
We are not just looking for a teacher. We are looking for a liberator. A teacher can tell you what to do. A liberator can set you free. Jesus is both. He teaches us the truth. He sets us free from sin.


The Prayer
God, thank you for sending Jesus. He is greater than Moses. He speaks your words. Help me to listen to Him. Help me to follow Him. Set me free from the things that hold me back. Amen.
pages.title: Day 5: The Blueprint of the Prophet

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a tree? It shows you the roots. It shows you the trunk. It shows you the branches. The Bible has a blueprint for a branch. It is a blueprint for a king. It is a blueprint for the one who would grow from a dead stump. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"A shoot will come up from the stump of Jesse; from his roots a Branch will bear fruit." - Isaiah 11:1 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Jesse was the father of King David. David was a great king. But his family line looked like a dead stump. Israel was in trouble. The kingdom was divided. The kings were weak. It looked like the royal line was finished. But Isaiah said, "A shoot will come up from the stump of Jesse." He said a Branch would bear fruit. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"And again, Isaiah says, 'The Root of Jesse will spring up, one who will arise to rule over the nations; in him the Gentiles will hope.'" - Romans 15:12


Jesus is that Branch. He came from the line of David. He came from the stump of Jesse. He is the King who rose from a dead family line. And Paul says something amazing in Romans. He says the Gentiles will hope in Him. This Branch is not just for one nation. He is for the whole world. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
The prophet Isaiah said a dead stump would come alive. He said the royal line would continue. Four hundred years passed. The line seemed dead. Then Jesus was born. The Branch grew. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
God specializes in bringing life out of broken things. Are you feeling like a dead stump? Are you feeling like something in your life is finished? Maybe a dream died. Maybe a relationship ended. God can bring a green shoot. He can bring new life.


The Prayer
God, you bring life out of dead things. Thank you for the Branch that grew from the stump of Jesse. Thank you for Jesus. I ask you to bring new life to the broken places in my heart. Bring new life to my dreams. Bring new life to my family. Amen.
pages.title: Day 6: The Blueprint of the Branch

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a miracle? It shows you the impossible. It shows you the supernatural. It shows you the hand of God. The Bible has a blueprint for a miracle. It is a blueprint for the virgin birth. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and will call him Immanuel." - Isaiah 7:14 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah was speaking to a king named Ahaz. Ahaz was a wicked king. He was worried about enemies. God told him to ask for a sign. Ahaz refused. So God said, "I will give you a sign anyway." And the sign was a virgin giving birth. The child would be called Immanuel. Immanuel means "God with us." It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and they will call him Immanuel" (which means "God with us"). - Matthew 1:23


Matthew tells us that Jesus is the fulfillment of this prophecy. Mary was a virgin. She became pregnant by the power of the Holy Spirit. She gave birth to Jesus. He is God with us. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about a miracle. It cannot be explained away by coincidence. It cannot be explained by natural means. It requires a supernatural event. If the prophecy is true, then Jesus is not just a good teacher. He is God.


The Resonance
We serve a God who does impossible things. Are you facing an impossible situation? A problem no doctor can fix? A relationship no counselor can fix? A financial situation no bank can fix? God can do the impossible. He is the God of the impossible.


The Prayer
God, you are the God of the impossible. Thank you for sending Jesus, born of a virgin. Thank you that you are with us. Help me to believe that you can do impossible things in my life. Help me to trust you with the impossible. Amen.
pages.title: Day 7: The Blueprint of the Virgin Birth

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a town? It shows you the streets. It shows you the houses. It shows you the people. The Bible has a blueprint for a town. It is a blueprint for the town where the Messiah would be born. It is a blueprint for Bethlehem.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, though you are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come for me one who will be ruler over Israel, whose origins are from of old, from ancient times." - Micah 5:2 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Micah was a prophet. He was looking at the towns of Judah. He said, "Bethlehem, you are small." Bethlehem was a small town. It was not a capital. It was not a major city. But Micah said the ruler of Israel would come from Bethlehem. This was a specific address. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"So Joseph also went up from the town of Nazareth in Galilee to Judea, to Bethlehem the town of David, because he belonged to the house and line of David." - Luke 2:4


Joseph and Mary lived in Nazareth. They were far from Bethlehem. But the Roman emperor Caesar Augustus ordered a census. Every person had to go to their ancestral town to register. Joseph was from the line of David. David was from Bethlehem. So Joseph traveled to Bethlehem. And Mary went with him. She gave birth in Bethlehem. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
It is statistically impossible to orchestrate your own birthplace. You cannot control where you are born. But the prophet knew. He named the town. And the Roman census made it happen. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
God pays attention to details. If He cared enough to arrange the exact birthplace of His son, He cares about the details of your life. He cares about your address. He cares about your family. He cares about the small things.


The Prayer
God, thank you for caring about details. Thank you for planning every step of your son's life. Thank you that you care about my life too. Help me to trust you with the small things. Help me to trust you with the big things. Amen.
pages.title: Day 8: The Blueprint of Bethlehem

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a child? It shows you the baby. It shows you the son. It shows you the future. The Bible has a blueprint for a child. It is a blueprint for the one who would be called Mighty God. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"For to us a child is born, to us a son is given, and the government will be on his shoulders. And he will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace." - Isaiah 9:6 (Written around 700 B.C.)


These are big titles. Wonderful Counselor. Mighty God. Everlasting Father. Prince of Peace. These are not titles for a normal child. These are titles for God. Isaiah said the child would be God. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"I and the Father are one." - John 10:30


Jesus made a claim that shocked everyone. He said, "I and the Father are one." He was saying He is God. The religious leaders tried to kill Him for saying this. They knew what He meant. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
Jesus did not just claim to be a prophet. He did not just claim to be a teacher. He claimed to be God. The prophecy said the child would be Mighty God. Jesus claimed to be Mighty God. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
Spirituality is not just about reaching up. The Divine reached down. God did not just send a message. He sent Himself. He came in the form of a baby. He came to be with us.


The Prayer
Jesus, you are Mighty God. Thank you for coming to earth. Thank you for stepping down from heaven. Thank you for being the Everlasting Father. Help me to know you more. Help me to love you more. Amen.
pages.title: Day 9: The Blueprint of the Child

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a journey? It shows you the map. It shows you the route. It shows you the destination. The Bible has a blueprint for a journey. It is a blueprint for the journey to Egypt. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"When Israel was a child, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son." - Hosea 11:1 (Written around 750 B.C.)


Hosea wrote this about the nation of Israel. God called Israel out of Egypt in the book of Exodus. But Matthew saw a deeper meaning. He saw that this verse also pointed to Jesus. Jesus is the true Son of God. He also came out of Egypt. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"So he got up, took the child and his mother during the night and left for Egypt, where he stayed until the death of Herod. And so was fulfilled what the Lord had said through the prophet: 'Out of Egypt I called my son.'" - Matthew 2:14-15


King Herod was jealous. He wanted to kill the baby Jesus. An angel appeared to Joseph in a dream. The angel said, "Get up. Take the child and his mother and escape to Egypt." Joseph obeyed. He took Mary and Jesus and fled to Egypt. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a strange prophecy. It was originally about the nation of Israel. But Matthew applies it to Jesus. Jesus is the true Israel. He goes to Egypt. He comes back. It is another layer in the blueprint.


The Resonance
Jesus knows what it feels like to be displaced. He knows what it feels like to be afraid. He knows what it feels like to be a refugee. He understands your fears.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for understanding what it feels like to be afraid. Thank you for being with me when I am scared. Thank you for protecting me. Thank you for being my refuge. Amen.
pages.title: Day 10: The Blueprint of Egypt

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for grief? It shows you the tears. It shows you the pain. It shows you the sorrow. The Bible has a blueprint for grief. It is a blueprint for the weeping of Rachel. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"This is what the LORD says: 'A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.'" - Jeremiah 31:15 (Written around 600 B.C.)


Jeremiah was writing about the exile of Israel. The people of Israel were being taken away to Babylon. Rachel was the mother of Joseph and Benjamin. She was a symbol of all the mothers of Israel. The prophecy says she is weeping. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"When Herod realized that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was furious, and he gave orders to kill all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under..." - Matthew 2:16


When the wise men did not return to King Herod, he was furious. He ordered that all the boys in Bethlehem who were two years old and under be killed. The mothers of Bethlehem wept. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a dark prophecy. It is a prophecy about human evil. King Herod was a tyrant. He killed innocent children. But even in this darkness, the prophecy was fulfilled. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
The Bible does not ignore pain. It enters into it. God is with you in your grief. He sees your tears. He collects them in a bottle.


The Prayer
God, you see my tears. You know my pain. Thank you for not ignoring my suffering. Thank you for being with me in the darkness. Comfort me today. Comfort those who are grieving. Amen.
pages.title: Day 11: The Blueprint of Weeping

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a voice? It shows you the sound. It shows you the message. It shows you the messenger. The Bible has a blueprint for a voice. It is a blueprint for the voice in the wilderness. It is a blueprint for John the Baptist.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"A voice of one calling: 'In the wilderness prepare the way for the LORD; make straight in the desert a highway for our God.'" - Isaiah 40:3 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah wrote about a voice in the wilderness. This voice would cry out. It would tell people to prepare the way for the Lord. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea and saying, 'Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.'" - Matthew 3:1-3


John the Baptist was that voice. He lived in the wilderness. He preached a message of repentance. He told people Jesus was coming. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
The Jews were waiting for this voice. They knew the prophecy. They asked John if he was the Messiah. He said no. He said he was just a voice. Jesus was the main act. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
Every spiritual awakening begins with preparation. A voice cries out. A heart gets ready. God wants to prepare you for something new.


The Prayer
God, thank you for the voices that point to Jesus. Thank you for the people who prepared the way for me to know you. Prepare my heart for what you have for me. Help me to be ready. Amen.
pages.title: Day 12: The Blueprint of the Voice

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a healer? It shows you the doctor. It shows you the medicine. It shows you the cure. The Bible has a blueprint for a healer. It is a blueprint for the one who would be anointed by the Spirit. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"The Spirit of the Sovereign LORD is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives and release from darkness for the prisoners..." - Isaiah 61:1 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah is speaking about the Messiah. He says the Spirit of the Lord is on Him. He is anointed to heal. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"He went to Nazareth... and on the Sabbath day he went into the synagogue... He stood up to read... 'The Spirit of the Lord is on me...' Then he began to say to them, 'Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.'" - Luke 4:16-21


Jesus went to His hometown. He read this exact passage. He said, "Today this scripture is fulfilled." The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
Jesus quoted this passage and applied it to Himself. He was the one Isaiah wrote about. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
This is your inheritance. Jesus came to heal your broken heart. He came to set you free. He came to give you good news.


The Prayer
Jesus, you are the healer. Thank you for binding up my broken heart. Thank you for setting me free from the things that hold me captive. Thank you for the good news. Heal me today. Amen.
pages.title: Day 13: The Blueprint of the Spirit

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for light? It shows you the sun. It shows you the lamp. It shows you the brightness. The Bible has a blueprint for light. It is a blueprint for the light in Galilee. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"The people walking in darkness have seen a great light; on those living in the land of deep darkness a light has dawned." - Isaiah 9:2 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah said the people walking in darkness would see a great light. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Leaving Nazareth, he went and lived in Capernaum... to fulfill what was said through the prophet Isaiah... the people living in darkness have seen a great light..." - Matthew 4:13-16


Jesus moved to Capernaum. He began His ministry there. He was the light in the darkness. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a geographical prophecy. It said the Messiah would bring light to Galilee. Jesus brought light to Galilee. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
God meets you where you are. No place is too dark for His light to reach.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being the light in the darkness. Thank you for shining your light in the dark places. Shine your light into my heart today. Amen.
pages.title: Day 14: The Blueprint of Light

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a building? It shows you the foundation. It shows you the walls. It shows you the cornerstone. The Bible has a blueprint for a cornerstone. It is a blueprint for the rejected stone. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone; the LORD has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes." - Psalm 118:22 (Written around 500 B.C.)


The builders looked at this stone and rejected it. But it became the cornerstone. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone; the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes" - Matthew 21:42


Jesus quoted this Psalm. He applied it to Himself. He was the rejected stone. He became the cornerstone. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about rejection and vindication. Jesus was rejected. He was exalted. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
When others reject you, remember that God sees your worth. You are a cornerstone.


The Prayer
God, thank you that you see my worth. Thank you that you do not reject me. Thank you that Jesus was rejected so that I could be accepted. Amen.
pages.title: Day 15: The Blueprint of the Stone

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for rejection? It shows you the pain. It shows you the hurt. It shows you the hatred. The Bible has a blueprint for hatred. It is a blueprint for the one who would be hated without a cause. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"Those who hate me without reason outnumber the hairs of my head..." - Psalm 69:4 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


David was being chased by his enemies. They hated him for no reason. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"They hated me without reason." - John 15:25


Jesus said the world hated Him without a reason. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the rejection of the Messiah. He would be hated. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
If you are hated for doing the right thing, you are in good company. Jesus understands.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for enduring hatred for me. Thank you for loving me even when others hated you. Help me to love those who hate me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 16: The Blueprint of Hatred

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for betrayal? It shows you the friend. It shows you the kiss. It shows you the knife. The Bible has a blueprint for betrayal. It is a blueprint for the one who would be betrayed by a friend. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"Even my close friend, someone I trusted, one who shared my bread, has turned against me." - Psalm 41:9 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


David was betrayed by a close friend. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"He who shared my bread has turned against me." - John 13:18


Jesus was betrayed by Judas. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about intimate betrayal. The Messiah would be betrayed by someone close. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
The greatest pain is not from enemies. It is from those we trust. Jesus understands.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for understanding the pain of betrayal. Thank you for being a friend who never betrays. Heal my heart from the wounds of broken friendships. Amen.
pages.title: Day 17: The Blueprint of Betrayal

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a price? It shows you the money. It shows you the coins. It shows you the silver. The Bible has a blueprint for a price. It is a blueprint for the thirty pieces of silver. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"So they paid me thirty pieces of silver..." - Zechariah 11:12 (Written around 500 B.C.)


Zechariah acted out a prophecy. He was paid thirty pieces of silver. It was a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"So they counted out for him thirty pieces of silver." - Matthew 26:15


Judas betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the exact amount of money. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
Jesus allowed Himself to be valued at the price of a slave. He valued you that much.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for valuing me enough to humble yourself. Thank you for allowing yourself to be sold for thirty pieces of silver. Thank you for loving me that much. Amen.
pages.title: Day 18: The Blueprint of Silver

Jesus was silent during His trial. The blueprint was fulfilled.

This is a prophecy about the behavior of the Messiah during his trial. He would be silent. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
Sometimes the most powerful thing you can do is be silent. Trusting God in the face of false accusations is strength.

The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being silent so that I could speak to God. Thank you for enduring false accusations. Help me to trust you when I am accused. Help me to be silent when I need to be. Amen.

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a flock? It shows you the shepherd. It shows you the sheep. It shows you the scattering. The Bible has a blueprint for a scattered flock. It is a blueprint for the shepherd who would be struck. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"Awake, sword, against my shepherd, against the man who is close to me! declares the LORD Almighty. Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, and I will turn my hand against the little ones." - Zechariah 13:7 (Written around 500 B.C.)


Zechariah says the sword will strike the shepherd. The shepherd will be smitten. And then the sheep will be scattered. This is a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Then Jesus told them, 'This very night you will all fall away on account of me, for it is written: "I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered."'" - Matthew 26:31


Jesus quoted this prophecy. He told His disciples they would all fall away. Jesus was arrested. The disciples ran away. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the disciples. They were the sheep. They would scatter. Jesus was the shepherd. He would be struck. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
Even when you fail or run away, Jesus does not abandon you. He is the Good Shepherd who goes after the scattered sheep.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for never giving up on me. Thank you for coming after me when I run away. Thank you for being the Good Shepherd. Help me to stop running. Help me to stay close to you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 20: The Blueprint of the Scattered Sheep

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a criminal? It shows you the jail. It shows you the chains. It shows you the cross. The Bible has a blueprint for a criminal's death. It is a blueprint for the one who would be crucified with sinners. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"Therefore I will give him a portion among the great, and he will divide the spoils with the strong, because he poured out his life unto death, and was numbered with the transgressors. For he bore the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors." - Isaiah 53:12 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah says the Messiah would be numbered with the transgressors. Transgressors are criminals. He would be crucified with criminals. This is a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Two other men, both criminals, were also led out with him to be executed... they crucified him there, along with the criminals..." - Luke 23:32-33


Jesus was crucified between two criminals. He was numbered with the transgressors. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the method of execution. The Messiah would be crucified with criminals. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
The innocent was treated like the guilty so the guilty could be set free. Jesus took your place.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for being numbered with the criminals so I could be numbered with the saints. Thank you for forgiving me. Thank you for taking my place. Help me to forgive others. Amen.
pages.title: Day 21: The Blueprint of the Criminals

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a wound? It shows you the mark. It shows you the scar. It shows you the pain. The Bible has a blueprint for a wound. It is a blueprint for pierced hands and feet. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"Dogs surround me, a pack of villains encircles me; they pierce my hands and my feet." - Psalm 22:16 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


David is describing a scene of suffering. He says they pierce his hands and his feet. This is a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Unless I see the nail marks in his hands and put my finger where the nails were... I will not believe." - John 20:25


Thomas saw the nail marks in Jesus' hands. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
Crucifixion did not exist when David wrote this Psalm. The fact that David predicted pierced hands and feet is stunning. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
The scars of Jesus are proof of His love for you. He bears those marks for eternity.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for the scars you bear for me. Thank you for the nail marks in your hands. Thank you for loving me that much. Help me to never forget your sacrifice. Amen.
pages.title: Day 22: The Blueprint of Pierced Hands

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for mockery? It shows you the crowd. It shows you the insults. It shows you the shaking heads. The Bible has a blueprint for mockery. It is a blueprint for the one who would be mocked. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"All who see me mock me; they hurl insults, shaking their heads. 'He trusts in the LORD,' they say, 'let the LORD rescue him. Let him deliver him, since he delights in him.'" - Psalm 22:7-8 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


David is describing the mockers. They mock him. They hurl insults. They shake their heads. This is a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads... 'He trusts in God. Let God rescue him now if he wants him...'" - Matthew 27:39-43


This is exactly what happened at the crucifixion. The people mocked Jesus. They shook their heads. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
The exact words of the mockers were predicted a thousand years before they said them. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
When people mock your faith, remember that you are in good company. Jesus faced the same thing and overcame it.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for enduring mockery for me. Thank you for not coming down from the cross. Help me to stand strong when my faith is mocked. Amen.
pages.title: Day 23: The Blueprint of Mocking

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a drink? It shows you the cup. It shows you the water. It shows you the wine. The Bible has a blueprint for a drink. It is a blueprint for gall and vinegar. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"They put gall in my food and gave me vinegar for my thirst." - Psalm 69:21 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


David is describing his suffering. He says they gave him gall and vinegar. This is a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"There they offered Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall... Jesus said, 'I am thirsty.' A jar of wine vinegar was there..." - Matthew 27:34; John 19:28-29


The soldiers offered Jesus gall and vinegar. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the smallest details of the crucifixion. Jesus experienced both. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
Even in suffering, Jesus fulfilled the smallest details of prophecy. He is a God of precision and love.


The Prayer
God, I trust you even in the small painful details of my life. Thank you for fulfilling every detail of the prophecy. Thank you for your precision. Help me to trust you with the details. Amen.
pages.title: Day 24: The Blueprint of Gall and Vinegar

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for clothes? It shows you the fabric. It shows you the thread. It shows you the color. The Bible has a blueprint for clothes. It is a blueprint for the garments divided by lot. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"They divide my clothes among them and cast lots for my garment." - Psalm 22:18 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


David is describing the scene at the crucifixion. They divided his clothes. They cast lots for his garment. This is a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took his clothes... 'Let's decide by lot who will get it.'" - John 19:23-24


The soldiers gambled for the garment of Jesus. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the random actions of the soldiers. God used their random actions to fulfill His word. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
Nothing that happens to you is outside of God's plan. Even the smallest details of your life are in His hands.


The Prayer
Thank you, God, for being in control of every detail. Even the random things in my life are under your care. Help me to trust you. Help me to rest in your sovereignty. Amen.
pages.title: Day 25: The Blueprint of Garments

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for loneliness? It shows you the empty room. It shows you the silence. It shows you the separation. The Bible has a blueprint for loneliness. It is a blueprint for the cry of forsakenness. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from my cries of anguish?" - Psalm 22:1 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


David felt abandoned by God. He cried out, "My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?" This is a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"About three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, 'Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?' (which means 'My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?')." - Matthew 27:46


Jesus quoted this Psalm on the cross. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the spiritual agony of the Messiah. He would feel forsaken. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
Because Jesus experienced separation from God on the cross, you will never have to. You will never be forsaken.


The Prayer
Thank you, Jesus, that I will never be forsaken. Thank you for experiencing separation so that I could experience acceptance. Thank you for the access I have to the Father. Amen.
pages.title: Day 26: The Blueprint of Forsakenness

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a tomb? It shows you the cave. It shows you the stone. It shows you the darkness. The Bible has a blueprint for a tomb. It is a blueprint for the rich man's tomb. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"He was assigned a grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death..." - Isaiah 53:9 (Written around 700 B.C.)


Isaiah says the Messiah would be buried with the rich. This is a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"As evening approached, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph... He placed it in his own new tomb..." - Matthew 27:57-60


Joseph of Arimathea buried Jesus in his own new tomb. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the burial of the Messiah. He would be buried by a rich man. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
Even in death, God honored His Son. He will honor you too.


The Prayer
God, I trust you to honor me in my life and in my death. Thank you for the hope of the resurrection. Thank you for the empty tomb. Help me to live with eternity in mind. Amen.
pages.title: Day 27: The Blueprint of the Tomb

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a resurrection? It shows you the empty tomb. It shows you the folded cloth. It shows you the risen King. The Bible has a blueprint for a resurrection. It is a blueprint for the one who would not stay in the grave. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest secure, because you will not abandon me to the realm of the dead, nor will you let your faithful one see decay." - Psalm 16:9-10 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


David said God would not abandon him to the realm of the dead. This is a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"God has raised this Jesus to life, and we are all witnesses of it." - Acts 2:32


God raised Jesus to life. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is the cornerstone of the Christian faith. The tomb is empty. Jesus rose from the dead. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
Death is not the end of the story. The grave is not the final word. Jesus is alive.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for rising from the dead. Thank you for defeating death. Thank you that the grave is empty. Because you live, I will live forever. Amen.
pages.title: Day 28: The Blueprint of Resurrection

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a victory? It shows you the throne. It shows you the crown. It shows you the glory. The Bible has a blueprint for a victory. It is a blueprint for the ascension. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"When you ascended on high, you took many captives; you received gifts from people, even from the rebellious—that you, LORD God, might dwell there." - Psalm 68:18 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


David describes a victorious king who ascends on high. This is a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"When he ascended on high, he took many captives and gave gifts to his people." - Ephesians 4:8


Paul applies this to Jesus. Jesus ascended on high. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is a prophecy about the ascension of the Messiah. He would ascend on high. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Resonance
Jesus has taken back the keys of death and hell. You have access to His victory and His gifts.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for sharing your victory with me. Thank you for the gifts you give me. Thank you for ascending on high. Help me to walk in your victory. Amen.
pages.title: Day 29: The Blueprint of Ascension

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a blueprint for a kingdom? It shows you the king. It shows you the throne. It shows you the forever. The Bible has a blueprint for a kingdom. It is a blueprint for the eternal throne. It is a blueprint for Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"In my vision at night I looked, and there before me was one like a son of man, coming with the clouds of heaven... He was given authority, glory and sovereign power... His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away..." - Daniel 7:13-14 (Written around 600 B.C.)


Daniel saw a vision of one like a son of man. He was given an everlasting dominion. This is a blueprint.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord and of his Messiah, and he will reign for ever and ever." - Revelation 11:15


Jesus reigns forever. The blueprint was fulfilled.


The Verdict
This is the final clue. The blueprint does not end with a cross. It ends with a crown. Jesus is the King of Kings.


The Resonance
The story is not just a historical mystery. It is a future reality. Jesus is coming back. He will reign forever.


The Prayer
Jesus, I give my life to you. Take my life and use it for your kingdom. Thank you for the hope of eternity. Thank you for the promise of a forever kingdom. Come, Lord Jesus. Amen.



END MATTER


The 300+ Prophecy Challenge
We only looked at 30 prophecies in this book. The Bible contains over 300 prophecies about Jesus. If you want to keep investigating, I challenge you to read the Gospel of John. It is 21 chapters. It tells the story of Jesus from the perspective of an eyewitness. As you read, look for the clues. Look for the prophecies. Look for the evidence. You will be amazed at what you find.


The Probability Factor
Mathematicians have calculated the probability of one person fulfilling just eight of these prophecies. The odds are 1 in 10 to the 17th power. That is a one with seventeen zeros after it. That is the same as covering the entire state of Texas with silver coins, marking one coin, and having a blindfolded person pick the right coin on the first try. Jesus fulfilled not eight. Not thirty. Over three hundred. The math points to a miracle.


A Note on Faith
Evidence is important. It satisfies the mind. But evidence does not save you. The evidence points to a person. The evidence points to Jesus. You can believe the facts and still be far from God. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The evidence is on the table. The door is open. It is your choice.


About the Author
Christine A. writes for the spiritually curious. He is passionate about showing people the evidence that the Bible is true. He lives with his family and enjoys good coffee and long conversations with skeptics. He believes that honest questions deserve honest answers.


Coming Next: The Future Told
If you enjoyed this journey, the next book in the series goes deeper. The Future Told takes a 30 day look at how ancient voices predicted the life of Christ. It is for the seeker who wants to go further.
